highlights.title: Fix a tool's secret in one tap
highlights.text: When a bot's tools need a new secret, its card says "needs you in Tools". Open Tools takes you straight to that server's row, so you paste the secret and press Done.

highlights.title: The chat stays put while you read
highlights.text: Scroll up to read and the chat holds your place, even while a reply streams in or earlier messages load. It follows new replies again when you reach the bottom, send, or press jump to latest.

highlights.title: Each bot's replies wear its colour
highlights.text: A bot's reply bubble now has a dark tint of its avatar's colour, so in a team chat you can tell at a glance who is talking. Text inside stays easy to read.

fixes: A bot that meets a sign-in page for a site its tools cover now uses those tools instead of a browser sign-in.
kwant idles on less memory: the Find a tool directory now loads on your first search, not at startup.
Find a tool keeps the whole MCP directory, no longer cut off at 60,000 servers.
The bot browser no longer stalls about 8 seconds on some starts.
